subject: Brain's Immune System Changes at Midlife, NIH Study Finds
script: From Agewell Brief: Brain's Immune System Changes at Midlife, NIH Study Finds. New research suggests a major shift in brain immunity around middle age, which may be linked to cognitive decline and dementia risk. NIH-supported findings reveal a new aspect of human brain aging. Midlife immune changes may contribute to age-related cognitive decline. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
